spanish: No harán conmigo dioses de plata y dioses de oro; no harán a ustedes.

findings.issue: וֵאלֹהֵי זָהָב is the fronted object of the second לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ. Spanish joins dioses de oro to the first clause and leaves the second harán without that object.
findings.spanishSpan: y dioses de oro; no harán

findings.issue: לָכֶם is a preposition plus 2mp suffix (for you), the beneficiary of making. a ustedes makes the addressees the thing made.

notes: First-clause negative, 2pl qal, conmigo, and dioses de plata match the tokens.
